mapper.sql: taking_id, taking_code, taking_name, taking_date, taking_type, user_id, user_name, nick_name, blind_flag, frozen_flag, plan_id, plan_code, plan_name, start_time, end_time, status, del_flag, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: select from wm_stock_taking where taking_id = #{takingId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into wm_stock_taking (taking_code, taking_name, taking_date, taking_type, user_id, user_name, nick_name, blind_flag, frozen_flag, plan_id, plan_code, plan_name, start_time, end_time, status, del_flag, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{takingCode}, #{takingName}, #{takingDate}, #{takingType}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{nickName}, ifnull(#{blindFlag}, 'N'), ifnull(#{frozenFlag}, 'N'), #{planId}, #{planCode}, #{planName}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, 'PREPARE', '0', #{remark}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now())
mapper.update: update wm_stock_taking set taking_name = #{takingName}, user_id = #{userId}, user_name = #{userName}, nick_name = #{nickName}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where taking_id = #{takingId} and status = 'PREPARE' and del_flag = '0'
update wm_stock_taking set status = #{toStatus}, update_time = now() where taking_id = #{takingId} and status = #{fromStatus} and del_flag = '0'
update wm_stock_taking set del_flag = '1', update_time = now() where taking_id = #{takingId} and status = 'PREPARE'
